title: General Utilities Module
summary: This module provides a collection of general-purpose utility functions and classes for various tasks such as agent logging, data serialization, string manipulation, and task output management.

nodes.label: Agent Logging and Summarization
nodes.title: Agent Logging and Summarization
nodes.description: Provides utilities for displaying agent logs, including thoughts, tool usage, and final answers, and for summarizing conversation chunks.

nodes.label: Data Serialization
nodes.title: Data Serialization
nodes.description: Handles the serialization of various Python objects into JSON strings and the conversion of string paths to callable functions.

nodes.label: String Manipulation
nodes.title: String Manipulation
nodes.description: Offers utility functions for common string operations, such as slugification for URL-safe text.

nodes.label: Task Output Storage
nodes.title: Task Output Storage
nodes.description: Manages the storage, retrieval, and updating of task execution outputs, supporting features like replay and audit trails.

nodes.label: Streaming Output Handling
nodes.title: Streaming Output Handling
nodes.description: Provides a base class for handling streaming outputs, allowing iteration over chunks and access to the final result.

nodes.label: Guardrail Serialization
nodes.title: Guardrail Serialization
nodes.description: Serializes guardrail configurations for JSON checkpointing, ensuring proper handling of callable and non-callable guardrail values.

nodes.label: Tool Parameter Sanitization
nodes.title: Tool Parameter Sanitization
nodes.description: Sanitizes tool parameters for strict Bedrock Converse compatibility, aligning with Anthropic's grammar constraints.

nodes.label: Tool Filter Creation
nodes.title: Tool Filter Creation
nodes.description: Creates static tool filter functions based on allow/block lists for controlling tool access.

nodes.label: Security Configuration
nodes.title: Security Configuration
nodes.description: Manages security settings, including unique component fingerprints for identification and authentication.

nodes.label: Crew Chat Runner
nodes.title: Crew Chat Runner
nodes.description: Facilitates running crew tools with messages, integrating with the core crew functionality.

nodes.label: Printer Utility
nodes.title: Printer Utility
nodes.description: A utility from crewai-core for handling colored console output formatting.

nodes.label: Plus API Payloads
nodes.title: Plus API Payloads
nodes.description: Data structures for login and trace batch initialization used in the CrewAI Plus API.

groups.label: Core Utilities
groups.title: Core Utility Functions
groups.description: Contains fundamental utility functions for data handling, string operations, and logging within the CrewAI framework.

groups.label: Data Management
groups.title: Data Management Utilities
groups.description: Utilities focused on managing and persisting data, particularly task outputs.

groups.label: Security and API Integration
groups.title: Security and API Integration
groups.description: Components related to security configurations and integration with external APIs.
